mapper.select: SELECT child_id FROM child WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_parent cp INNER JOIN child c ON c.child_id = cp.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cp.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.member_type = 'PARENT' WHERE cp.child_id = #{childId} AND cp.member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT ar.asset_report_id, ar.child_id, ar.report_month, ar.total_asset_amount, ar.total_asset_change_amount, ar.monthly_saved_amount, ar.total_goal_target_amount, ar.total_goal_saved_amount, ar.goal_achievement_rate, ar.savings_goal_summary_json, ar.insight_items_json, ar.created_at, ar.updated_at FROM asset_report ar WHERE ar.child_id = #{childId} AND ar.report_month = #{reportMonth} LIMIT 1
SELECT child_id FROM child WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY child_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(abs.balance), 0) FROM account_balance_snapshot abs INNER JOIN ( SELECT financial_account_id, MAX(observed_at) AS latest_observed_at FROM account_balance_snapshot WHERE observed_at < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY financial_account_id ) latest ON latest.financial_account_id = abs.financial_account_id AND latest.latest_observed_at = abs.observed_at INNER JOIN financial_account fa ON fa.financial_account_id = abs.financial_account_id WHERE fa.child_id = #{childId} AND fa.account_product_type = 'SAVINGS' AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.account_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'MATURED')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(at.amount), 0) FROM account_transaction at INNER JOIN financial_account fa ON fa.financial_account_id = at.financial_account_id WHERE at.direction = 'CREDIT' AND fa.child_id = #{childId} AND fa.account_product_type = 'SAVINGS' AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.account_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'MATURED') AND at.occurred_at >= #{startAt} AND at.occurred_at < #{endExclusive}

SELECT fg.financial_goal_id AS financialGoalId, fg.title, fg.target_amount AS targetAmount, fg.monthly_saving_amount AS monthlySavingTargetAmount, fa.financial_account_id AS accountId, fa.account_name AS accountName, fa.bank_name AS bankName, fa.account_number_ciphertext AS accountNumberCiphertext, COALESCE( ( SELECT abs.balance FROM account_balance_snapshot abs WHERE abs.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id AND abs.observed_at < #{endExclusive} ORDER BY abs.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1 ), fa.balance, 0 ) AS balance, COALESCE( ( SELECT SUM(at.amount) FROM account_transaction at WHERE at.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id AND at.direction = 'CREDIT' AND at.occurred_at >= #{startAt} AND at.occurred_at < #{endExclusive} ), 0 ) AS monthlySavedAmount FROM financial_goal fg INNER JOIN financial_goal_account fga ON fga.financial_goal_id = fg.financial_goal_id INNER JOIN financial_account fa ON fa.financial_account_id = fga.financial_account_id WHERE fg.child_id = #{childId} AND fg.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ACHIEVED') AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.account_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'MATURED') ORDER BY fg.created_at ASC, fg.financial_goal_id ASC, fga.linked_at ASC, fga.financial_goal_account_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_report ( child_id, report_month, total_asset_amount, total_asset_change_amount, monthly_saved_amount, total_goal_target_amount, total_goal_saved_amount, goal_achievement_rate, six_month_flow_json, savings_goal_summary_json, insight_items_json ) VALUES ( #{childId}, #{reportMonth}, #{totalAssetAmount}, #{totalAssetChangeAmount}, #{monthlySavedAmount}, #{totalGoalTargetAmount}, #{totalGoalSavedAmount}, #{goalAchievementRate}, #{sixMonthFlowJson}, #{savingsGoalSummaryJson}, #{insightItemsJson} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_asset_amount = VALUES(total_asset_amount), total_asset_change_amount = VALUES(total_asset_change_amount), monthly_saved_amount = VALUES(monthly_saved_amount), total_goal_target_amount = VALUES(total_goal_target_amount), total_goal_saved_amount = VALUES(total_goal_saved_amount), goal_achievement_rate = VALUES(goal_achievement_rate), six_month_flow_json = VALUES(six_month_flow_json), savings_goal_summary_json = VALUES(savings_goal_summary_json), insight_items_json = VALUES(insight_items_json), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
